SidebarExpanded.Name: Open sidebar on startup
SidebarExpanded.Hint: Keep the right sidebar expanded when the game loads. If unchecked, it starts collapsed.

DarkChat.Name: Dark chat
DarkChat.Hint: Show the chat as white on black: a frame in the player's color around their messages, whispers in blue, system decorative backgrounds removed. Unchecked: original style.

JoinMusicPlaylist.Name: Join page playlist
JoinMusicPlaylist.Hint: Foundry playlist looped on the join page, in its order (or shuffled if it is in shuffle mode), with each track's volume. Local files and YouTube videos from the Jokerbox module. Playlist changes are picked up automatically. Takes precedence over the file below.

JoinMusic.Name: Join page music
JoinMusic.Hint: File looped on the join page when no playlist is chosen. The module writes the music into the world description: clear the playlist and this field before disabling the module. In a web browser, click the speaker at the bottom left. No effect with the "minimal" join theme.

JoinMusicVolume.Name: Join page music volume
JoinMusicVolume.Hint: Starting volume of the music on the join page. Each player can then adjust it for themselves with the speaker at the bottom left of the page.

Debug.Name: Debug log
Debug.Hint: Show in the console (F12) what the module is doing. Filter the console on liwil-qol to see only it. Specific to this browser.

ChatWhisper.Label: Whisper mode (in the list, Shift + click: several people)

JoinMusic.Error: Liwil QoL: could not save the join page music into the world description.
JoinMusic.Blocked: Liwil QoL: the music player was stripped from the world description when saving, the music will not be able to play.

FolderTextColor.Name: Text color
FolderTextColor.Hint: Color of the folder name in lists. Empty: Foundry's original color.
